# pre-commit doc-sync never refreshes OKF `generated`/`stale_after`, and doc-only commits skip it entirely

## Summary
AGENTS.md rule `okf-frontmatter` requires refreshing `generated`/`stale_after` in the same change as a material doc edit. In practice the pre-commit doc-sync hook does not do this, and `make okf-lint` cannot detect it, so `generated.at` drifts arbitrarily far behind the last material edit of many docs.

## Impact
- Doc provenance (`generated.by`/`generated.at`, `stale_after`) is misleading across `AGENTS.md` and several `.agents/skills/**/SKILL.md` files.
- The only mechanical enforcer, `make okf-lint`, checks `generated` **shape** (by/at co-presence) and `stale_after` **expiry** — not freshness — so staleness accumulates silently.
- External agents that key on the frontmatter get a wrong "last materially changed" signal.

## Evidence (current tree, `main` @ c94ddf2c)
| File | `generated.at` | Last commit touching it | Stale by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` | `2026-10-11T13:09:00Z` | `4e9f7f93` env flags, `2026-10-11T13:29:56Z` | ~21 min |
| `.agents/skills/cmd/SKILL.md` | `2026-10-10T17:02:00Z` | `c94ddf2c` LSP snippets, `2026-10-11T16:27:35Z` | ~1 day |
| `.agents/skills/stdlib/SKILL.md` | `2026-10-10T15:39:04Z` | `a5fd6ced` json capture, `2026-10-11T13:25:50Z` | ~1 day |
| `docs/cookbook.md` | `2026-10-11T13:24:57Z` | `a5fd6ced`, `2026-10-11T13:25:50Z` | ~1 min (fresh) |
| `.agents/skills/kukicha/troubleshooting.md` | `2026-10-11T12:50:00Z` | `8724e1fd`, `2026-10-11T12:48:22Z` | fresh |

`docs/cookbook.md` and `troubleshooting.md` show the mechanism *can* land a refresh, so this is inconsistent rather than never.

## Root cause (three, compounding)
1. **The doc-sync agent prompt never asks for a frontmatter refresh.** `scripts/pre-commit:186-221` lists the doc files and says "only update a file if the staged changes materially affect what it documents", but nothing instructs refreshing `generated`/`stale_after` (`okf-frontmatter`). The agent refreshes the prose and leaves the header alone.
2. **Doc-only commits skip doc-sync entirely.** `scripts/pre-commit:168-178` builds `$DIFF` excluding `AGENTS.md`, `stdlib/AGENTS.md`, `internal/AGENTS.md`, `docs/SKILL.md`, `docs/cookbook.md`, and `.agents/skills/**`; if that leaves nothing, the hook `exit 0`s before the agent runs. A commit whose only staged change is, e.g., `.agents/skills/cmd/SKILL.md` never gets a frontmatter refresh. (Confirmed on commit `bb379ae4`, which touched only `.agents/skills/pr-review/**` — the hook exited at line 177 and I had to bump `generated` by hand.)
3. **`make okf-lint` cannot catch it.** `scripts/okf.kuki:270-300` validates `generated` by/at co-presence and `stale_after` expiry only; there is no comparison of `generated.at` against the file's last material change.

## Reproducer
```sh
# (1) body edited, header not refreshed
git checkout -b tmp-okf-repro
printf '\n- `KUKICHA_REPRO=1` — repro line\n' >> AGENTS.md
git add AGENTS.md && git commit -m "docs: repro"
git show HEAD:AGENTS.md | sed -n '1,10p'   # generated.at unchanged from before the edit
make okf-lint                              # "40 docs checked, 0 issues" — passes anyway

# (2) doc-only commit skips doc-sync entirely
printf '\n<!-- repro -->\n' >> .agents/skills/cmd/SKILL.md
git add .agents/skills/cmd/SKILL.md && git commit -m "skills: repro"
# hook prints nothing: $DIFF is empty -> exit 0 before the agent runs
```

## Suggested fix (deterministic is better than LLM here)
- **Preferred:** a mechanical post-step in `scripts/pre-commit` (or its own `make` target) that, for every staged `.md` whose body changed, bumps `generated: { by: <configured agent>/<model>, at: <now> }` and `stale_after` (~3 months out), leaving `verified:` blank. Frontmatter is metadata; it should not depend on the LLM agent choosing to touch it.
- **Minimum:** add rule `okf-frontmatter` to the doc-sync agent prompt (`scripts/pre-commit:208-218`) so a material body edit also refreshes the header, and stop early-exiting for the excluded doc paths when those files are the staged change.
- **Gate:** extend `scripts/okf.kuki` (or a CI/make wrapper with git access) to flag a `.md` whose `generated.at` predates its last commit — otherwise nothing catches a regression.

## Related
Surfaced during the post-`v0.85.10` pr-review dry-run; the Doc Drift Check and Boundary Keeper lenses independently flagged stale `generated` on 6 of the 10 reviewed commits, while `make okf-lint` stayed green throughout. AGENTS.md rules: `okf-frontmatter` (23), `pre-commit-hook` (17).
value.title: pre-commit doc-sync never refreshes OKF generated/stale_after; doc-only commits skip it
